name: jwt_list_dictionaries
title: List JWT Dictionaries
description: List managed .txt dictionaries available for JWT HMAC checks. Call this before jwt_bruteforce.

descriptionI18n.en: List managed .txt dictionaries available for JWT HMAC checks. Call this before jwt_bruteforce.
descriptionI18n.zh: 列出 JWT 检测可用的托管 .txt 字典；调用 jwt_bruteforce 前必须先使用本工具。

name: space_engine_search
title: Space Engine Search
description: Search the configured asset search engines. Select engines, query, pagination and limits as needed.

descriptionI18n.en: Search the configured asset search engines. Select engines, query, pagination and limits as needed.
descriptionI18n.zh: 通过已配置的资产搜索引擎查询，按需指定引擎、查询条件和分页。

query.description: With a semantic queryType, pass only a plain value without a field prefix or extra quotes: query=example.com with queryType=domain; query=耀出行 with queryType=body. For compound searches use unified syntax, e.g. domain:example.com AND port:443, with queryType=default.

queryType.description: Semantic type for a plain value. default means unified query syntax, not arbitrary native engine syntax. icp.number means an ICP registration number, not a company name.

engines.description: Optional engine allowlist. Leave empty to use all configured engines. Valid values: fofa, hunter, quake, censys, zoomeye.

page.description: Result page number. Use 1 unless the user asks for another page.

pageSize.description: Number of results per page. Default is 20. Maximum is 100.

maxPages.description: Maximum pages to request per engine when the backend supports multi-page collection. Default is 1 and maximum is 5 to protect quota.

query.description: With a semantic queryType, pass only a plain value without a field prefix or extra quotes: query=example.com with queryType=domain; query=耀出行 with queryType=body. For compound searches use unified syntax, e.g. domain:example.com AND port:443, with queryType=default.

queryType.description: Semantic type for a plain value. default means unified query syntax, not arbitrary native engine syntax. icp.number means an ICP registration number, not a company name.

engines.description: Optional engine allowlist. Leave empty to use all configured engines. Valid values: fofa, hunter, quake, censys, zoomeye.

page.description: Result page number. Use 1 unless the user asks for another page.

pageSize.description: Number of results per page. Default is 20. Maximum is 100.

maxPages.description: Maximum pages to request per engine when the backend supports multi-page collection. Default is 1 and maximum is 5 to protect quota.

query.description: 指定 queryType 时只传纯值，不加字段或额外引号，例如 example.com 配 domain、耀出行配 body。复合查询使用统一语法 domain:example.com AND port:443，并指定 queryType=default。

queryType.description: 纯值的语义类型。default 表示统一查询语法，不是任意引擎原生语法；icp.number 表示备案号，不是公司名称。

engines.description: 可选引擎白名单。留空表示使用所有已配置引擎。合法值：fofa、hunter、quake、censys、zoomeye。

page.description: 结果页码。除非用户指定其他页，否则使用 1。

pageSize.description: 每页结果数量，默认 20，最大 100。

maxPages.description: 后端支持多页采集时，每个引擎最多请求的页数。默认 1，最大 5，用于保护配额。

name: space_engine_get_quota
title: Get Engine Quota
description: Read current account and quota information for configured space engines. Use this before or after searches when the user asks about remaining credits, quota health, or whether API limits may affect results. This tool is read-only but may contact third-party provider APIs.

descriptionI18n.en: Read current account and quota information for configured space engines. Use this before or after searches when the user asks about remaining credits, quota health, or whether API limits may affect results. This tool is read-only but may contact third-party provider APIs.
descriptionI18n.zh: 读取已配置空间引擎的账户和配额信息。当用户询问剩余额度、配额健康度或 API 限制是否影响结果时使用。该工具只读，但可能访问第三方服务商 API。

name: space_engine_get_config_status
title: Get Config Status
description: Return local configuration completeness for each supported space engine without exposing secrets. Use this to diagnose why search or quota tools may not work, or to tell the user which engines are configured. This tool is local and read-only.

descriptionI18n.en: Return local configuration completeness for each supported space engine without exposing secrets. Use this to diagnose why search or quota tools may not work, or to tell the user which engines are configured. This tool is local and read-only.
descriptionI18n.zh: 返回每个支持的空间引擎本地配置完整性，不暴露密钥。适用于诊断搜索或配额工具不可用原因，或告知用户哪些引擎已配置。该工具本地只读。

name: space_engine_native_search
title: Single Engine Native Search
description: Query one configured asset search engine using its native query syntax.

descriptionI18n.en: Query one configured asset search engine using its native query syntax.
descriptionI18n.zh: 使用已配置的单个资产搜索引擎及其原生语法查询。

query.description: Native query expression for the selected engine.

name: webscan_create_task
title: Create Scan Task
description: Create a manual scan task for one or more authorized targets. Supported scanType values are subdomain, webscan, portscan, dirscan, crack, and jsscan. Local scans start immediately and agent scans are queued for dispatch.

descriptionI18n.en: Create a manual scan task for one or more authorized targets. Supported scanType values are subdomain, webscan, portscan, dirscan, crack, and jsscan. Local scans start immediately and agent scans are queued for dispatch.
descriptionI18n.zh: 为一个或多个已授权目标创建手动扫描任务。scanType 支持 subdomain、webscan、portscan、dirscan、crack、jsscan。本地扫描会立即入队执行，agent 模式会创建下发任务。

scanType.description: Task type to create. subdomain discovers and resolves subdomains, webscan finds web vulnerabilities, portscan discovers services, dirscan discovers paths, crack runs weak-credential checks, and jsscan analyzes JavaScript assets.

targets.description: Authorized target URLs, hosts, domains, or IPs to scan. Use values appropriate for the selected scanType.

agentId.description: Optional agent id when scanMode is agent.

webscanOption.description: Website scan mode: 1 fingerprint/component detection, 2 full fingerprint, 3 fingerprint plus vulnerability scan, 4 targeted template scan.

portGroupId.description: Optional port-group id for portscan. Omit both this and portRange to use the system default port group.

portRange.description: Only set when the user explicitly requests a concrete port expression. Otherwise omit it and use the system default port group; do not invent 1-1000.

aliveDetection.description: Whether portscan should perform host liveness detection.

subnetDiscoveryEnabled.description: Opt-in /24 sampling for explicitly supplied IPv4 CIDRs larger than /24. Uses TCP host discovery ports and timeout; disabled by default.

subnetDiscoveryMode.description: full (default) prioritizes confirmed networks and retains remaining networks; fast skips unconfirmed networks and may miss devices.

subnetDiscoveryHostSuffixes.description: Comma-separated host suffixes 1-254, up to 32; default 1,2,254.

subnetDiscoveryRandomSamples.description: Additional samples per subnet, default 2. Zero disables random sampling.

tcpHeuristicEnabled.description: Opt-in TCP host discovery before port scanning. Unconfirmed hosts are skipped; may miss devices using other ports.

tcpHeuristicPorts.description: Comma-separated TCP probe ports, default 80,443,22,3389,445, up to 64 ports.

tcpHeuristicTimeoutMs.description: TCP host probe timeout in milliseconds, default 3000 (3 seconds).

tcpDiscoveryMode.description: TCP discovery mode. Omit to use the backend default connect; SYN requires local authorization.

synRate.description: SYN packet rate, used only when tcpDiscoveryMode=syn.

synDiscoveryAttempts.description: SYN discovery attempts, used only when tcpDiscoveryMode=syn; maximum 2.

paths.description: Inline paths or words selected by the AI. When provided, only these inputs and explicitly selected dictionaries are scanned unless defaultDict=true.

dictPaths.description: Dictionary file paths for dirscan. Prefer dictNames for platform managed dictionaries instead of guessing absolute paths.

dictNames.description: Platform managed dirscan dictionary names from the config/dirsearch dictionary directory, with or without the .txt suffix (e.g. common-modern, springboot, dicc).

statusCodeExclude.description: HTTP status codes to exclude from dirscan results.

username.description: Username or username dictionary for crack tasks.

password.description: Password or password dictionary for crack tasks.

defaultDict.description: For crack tasks, use the built-in per-protocol dictionaries; for dirscan tasks, explicitly load the platform default directory dictionary (common-modern, about 850 modern paths). It is not added when custom dirscan inputs are supplied unless set to true.

config.description: Optional advanced task config merged with the explicit fields above. Secrets are stored in the task config and redacted from MCP task reads.

name: attack_surface_create_webscan_task
title: Create Website Scan Task
description: Create a website scan task. webscanOption=2 collects fingerprints and assets; 3 adds nuclei checks using fingerprint tags and configured POC templates; 4 uses specified templates. Returns a task ID with scanType=webscan.

descriptionI18n.en: Create a website scan task. webscanOption=2 collects fingerprints and assets; 3 adds nuclei checks using fingerprint tags and configured POC templates; 4 uses specified templates. Returns a task ID with scanType=webscan.
descriptionI18n.zh: 创建网站扫描任务。webscanOption=2 为指纹和主动资产发现；3 在指纹识别后使用匹配标签和配置的 POC 库执行 nuclei；4 使用指定模板。返回任务 ID，scanType=webscan。

templateFiles.description: Optional custom POC template file paths.

tags.description: Optional nuclei tags; webscanOption=3 normally derives these from discovered fingerprints.

callNuclei.description: Enable the embedded nuclei SDK vulnerability checks against the configured custom POC library.

webscanOption.description: Website scan mode: 1 fingerprint/component detection, 2 full fingerprint only, 3 full fingerprint plus nuclei vulnerability scan using fingerprint-derived tags and the custom POC library, 4 targeted template scan. Defaults to 3 for regular Web security testing; use 2 only for explicit fingerprint-only requests.

name: attack_surface_create_portscan_task
title: Create Port Scan Task
description: Create an attack-surface port scan and service identification task. This tool always creates scanType=portscan.

descriptionI18n.en: Create an attack-surface port scan and service identification task. This tool always creates scanType=portscan.
descriptionI18n.zh: 创建攻击面评估中的端口扫描与服务识别任务。该工具固定创建 scanType=portscan。

targets.description: Authorized hosts, IPs, domains, or CIDR ranges to scan.

portGroupId.description: Optional port-group id. Omit both this and portRange to use the system default port group.

portRange.description: Only set when the user explicitly requests a concrete port expression. Otherwise omit it and use the system default port group; do not invent 1-1000.

subnetDiscoveryEnabled.description: Opt-in /24 sampling for explicitly supplied IPv4 CIDRs larger than /24. Uses TCP host discovery ports and timeout; disabled by default.

subnetDiscoveryMode.description: full (default) prioritizes confirmed networks and retains remaining networks; fast skips unconfirmed networks and may miss devices.

subnetDiscoveryHostSuffixes.description: Comma-separated host suffixes 1-254, up to 32; default 1,2,254.

subnetDiscoveryRandomSamples.description: Additional samples per subnet, default 2. Zero disables random sampling.

tcpHeuristicEnabled.description: Opt-in TCP host discovery before port scanning. Unconfirmed hosts are skipped; may miss devices using other ports.

tcpHeuristicPorts.description: Comma-separated TCP probe ports, default 80,443,22,3389,445, up to 64 ports.

tcpHeuristicTimeoutMs.description: TCP host probe timeout in milliseconds, default 3000 (3 seconds).

tcpDiscoveryMode.description: TCP discovery mode. Omit to use the backend default connect; SYN requires local authorization.

synRate.description: SYN packet rate, used only when tcpDiscoveryMode=syn.

synDiscoveryAttempts.description: SYN discovery attempts, used only when tcpDiscoveryMode=syn; maximum 2.

name: attack_surface_create_dirscan_task
title: Create Directory Scan Task
description: Create an attack-surface directory brute-force and sensitive-file discovery task. This tool always creates scanType=dirscan.

descriptionI18n.en: Create an attack-surface directory brute-force and sensitive-file discovery task. This tool always creates scanType=dirscan.
descriptionI18n.zh: 创建攻击面评估中的目录爆破与敏感文件探测任务。该工具固定创建 scanType=dirscan。

paths.description: Inline paths or words selected by the AI. When provided, only these inputs and explicitly selected dictionaries are scanned unless defaultDict=true.

dictPaths.description: Dictionary file paths. Prefer dictNames for platform managed dictionaries instead of guessing absolute paths.

dictNames.description: Platform managed dirscan dictionary names from the config/dirsearch dictionary directory, with or without the .txt suffix (e.g. common-modern, springboot, dicc).

defaultDict.description: Load the platform default directory dictionary (common-modern, about 850 modern paths). It is not added when custom inputs are supplied unless this is explicitly true.

name: attack_surface_create_crack_task
title: Create Password Brute Force Task
description: Create an attack-surface weak credential detection and brute-force task. This tool always creates scanType=crack.

descriptionI18n.en: Create an attack-surface weak credential detection and brute-force task. This tool always creates scanType=crack.
descriptionI18n.zh: 创建攻击面评估中的弱口令检测与密码暴破任务。该工具固定创建 scanType=crack。

targets.description: Authorized service targets such as ssh://host:22, mysql://host:3306, or protocol://host:port.

name: attack_surface_create_jsscan_task
title: Create JS/API Collection Task

titleI18n.zh: 创建 JS/API 采集任务

description: Create a katana-like attack-surface JavaScript/API collection task. By default this identifies JavaScript resources, API endpoints, API roots, site tree data, and sensitive-information candidates, and caches JavaScript content in the database without running vulnerability probes. Set config.vulnDetection.enabled=true to include unauthorized-access and parameter vulnerability checks.

descriptionI18n.en: Create a katana-like attack-surface JavaScript/API collection task. By default this identifies JavaScript resources, API endpoints, API roots, site tree data, and sensitive-information candidates, and caches JavaScript content in the database without running vulnerability probes. Set config.vulnDetection.enabled=true to include unauthorized-access and parameter vulnerability checks.
descriptionI18n.zh: 创建攻击面评估中的 JavaScript/API 采集任务，对标 katana 识别 JS、接口和 API 根路径。默认采集 JS 资源、API endpoint、API root、网站树和敏感信息候选，并将 JS 内容缓存到数据库，不执行漏洞探测。设置 config.vulnDetection.enabled=true 可开启未授权访问和参数类漏洞检测。

targets.description: Authorized URLs whose JavaScript assets should be analyzed.

config.description: Optional JS/API collection configuration. Use vulnDetection.enabled=false for katana-like collection-only mode with JS content caching; use vulnDetection.enabled=true for full JS/API testing. Supported examples include blackDomain, highRiskRouter, authentication, placeholder, vulnDetection, proxy, or openai.

name: webscan_get_task
title: Get Webscan Task
description: Read webscan task status, progress, counts, severity summary, and redacted task configuration.

descriptionI18n.en: Read webscan task status, progress, counts, severity summary, and redacted task configuration.
descriptionI18n.zh: 读取漏洞扫描任务状态、进度、结果数量、漏洞等级汇总和已脱敏任务配置。

name: webscan_list_vulnerabilities
title: List Webscan Vulnerabilities
description: List vulnerabilities found by a webscan task with pagination and optional search, severity, and disposal-status filters.

descriptionI18n.en: List vulnerabilities found by a webscan task with pagination and optional search, severity, and disposal-status filters.
descriptionI18n.zh: 分页读取漏洞扫描任务发现的漏洞，支持搜索、漏洞等级和处置状态筛选。

name: webscan_list_results
title: List Scan Results
description: List results for webscan, crack, portscan, dirscan, or jsscan tasks. By default the result type is inferred from the task scanType; callers may override resultType. For jsscan collection tasks, auto returns JS/API assets; request js_resources, js_api_resources, js_site_tree, or js_vulnerabilities when specific data is needed.

descriptionI18n.en: List results for webscan, crack, portscan, dirscan, or jsscan tasks. By default the result type is inferred from the task scanType; callers may override resultType. For jsscan collection tasks, auto returns JS/API assets; request js_resources, js_api_resources, js_site_tree, or js_vulnerabilities when specific data is needed.
descriptionI18n.zh: 读取 webscan、crack、portscan、dirscan 或 jsscan 任务结果。默认根据任务 scanType 自动选择结果类型，也可以通过 resultType 指定。对 jsscan 采集任务，auto 返回 JS/API 资产；需要特定数据时可指定 js_resources、js_api_resources、js_site_tree 或 js_vulnerabilities。

resultType.description: Optional result set selector. auto maps webscan/crack to vulnerabilities, portscan to ports, dirscan to dir_results, and jsscan to js_assets. Use js_resources for collected JavaScript files, js_api_resources for observed API requests/responses, js_site_tree for site tree data, and js_vulnerabilities only when vulnDetection.enabled was used.

status.description: HTTP status code filter for dir_results, js_resources, or js_api_resources.

method.description: HTTP method filter for js_vulnerabilities or js_api_resources.

assetType.description: Optional JS asset type filter for js_assets, such as apiRoute, apiRoot, email, phone, idCard, sensitive, or ipUrl.

includeContent.description: When listing js_resources or js_api_resources, include truncated JS content or request/response bodies. Defaults to false to control token usage.

includeTree.description: When listing js_site_tree, include parsed treeData instead of summary-only rows. Defaults to false to control token usage.

name: subdomain_create_task
title: Create Attack Surface Subdomain Task

titleI18n.zh: 创建攻击面子域名任务

description: Create an attack-surface subdomain discovery task. It appears in Attack Surface Assessment and uses local configuration for API keys and AI settings. When appendEngines is omitted, it uses configured search engines plus Digitorus, HackerTarget, THC, Anubis, and the existing IP138 source.

descriptionI18n.en: Create an attack-surface subdomain discovery task. It appears in Attack Surface Assessment and uses local configuration for API keys and AI settings. When appendEngines is omitted, it uses configured search engines plus Digitorus, HackerTarget, THC, Anubis, and the existing IP138 source.
descriptionI18n.zh: 创建攻击面评估中的子域名发现任务。任务会显示在攻击面评估中，API Key 和 AI 配置从本地设置读取。未传 appendEngines 时默认使用已配置的搜索引擎，并启用 Digitorus、HackerTarget、THC、Anubis 和原有 IP138 源。

agentId.description: Optional agent id when scanMode is agent.

appendEngines.description: Optional engine allowlist. Leave empty to use configured engines plus digitorus, hackertarget, thc, anubis, and ip138.

name: subdomain_get_task
title: Get Attack Surface Subdomain Task

titleI18n.zh: 获取攻击面子域名任务

description: Read attack-surface subdomain task status, lifecycle details, result count, and redacted task configuration.

descriptionI18n.en: Read attack-surface subdomain task status, lifecycle details, result count, and redacted task configuration.
descriptionI18n.zh: 读取攻击面子域名任务状态、生命周期信息、结果数量和已脱敏任务配置。

name: subdomain_list_results
title: List Attack Surface Subdomain Results

titleI18n.zh: 获取攻击面子域名结果

description: List attack-surface subdomain discovery results with limit/offset pagination and optional source or text filter.

descriptionI18n.en: List attack-surface subdomain discovery results with limit/offset pagination and optional source or text filter.
descriptionI18n.zh: 按 limit/offset 分页读取攻击面子域名发现结果，支持来源和文本筛选。

name: company_create_task
title: Create Company Intelligence Task
description: Create an asynchronous company intelligence task for one or more company names using configured data sources such as Riskbird, MIIT, or 0.zone.

descriptionI18n.en: Create an asynchronous company intelligence task for one or more company names using configured data sources such as Riskbird, MIIT, or 0.zone.
descriptionI18n.zh: 为一个或多个企业名称创建异步企业信息收集任务，支持风鸟、工信部、0.zone 等数据源。

company.description: One or more company names separated by newlines.

name: company_get_task
title: Get Company Task
description: Read company intelligence task status, progress, and redacted task configuration.

descriptionI18n.en: Read company intelligence task status, progress, and redacted task configuration.
descriptionI18n.zh: 读取企业信息任务状态、进度和已脱敏任务配置。

name: company_get_results
title: Get Company Results
description: Return normalized company intelligence results for a completed company task.

descriptionI18n.en: Return normalized company intelligence results for a completed company task.
descriptionI18n.zh: 返回已完成企业信息任务的标准化企业信息结果。

name: jwt_bruteforce
title: JWT Weak Secret Check
description: Check JWT HMAC secrets using an existing managed .txt dictionary basename returned by jwt_list_dictionaries.

descriptionI18n.en: Check JWT HMAC secrets using an existing managed .txt dictionary basename returned by jwt_list_dictionaries.
descriptionI18n.zh: 使用 jwt_list_dictionaries 返回的现有托管 .txt 文件名检测 JWT HMAC 弱密钥。

token.description: JWT token with three dot-separated segments.

dictionary.description: Existing managed JWT .txt basename returned by jwt_list_dictionaries, for example dic.txt. Do not use jwt, jwt.secrets.list, or an absolute local path.

source.description: Managed dictionary source. Defaults to jwt.
